source_text:
ἀπόλλυσθαι τὸν αἰῶνα, τὸ εἶναι φθαρτοὺς κατὰ πάντα καιρὸν, τό γε ἧκον εἰς τὸν τοῦ
πεποιῆσθαι λόγον· εἴ
pass_a_gloss: …to perish the age — the being perishable according to every time, at least as far as reaches into the account of the having-been-made; if…
pass_b_english: …to perish through the age — that is, to be perishable at every time, so far as the account of having been made reaches; if…
